import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    ids = [int(data[1 + 2 * i]) for i in range(n)]
    qs = [int(data[2 + 2 * i]) for i in range(n)]
    lines = []
    for i in range(n):
        first = True
        for j in range(i):
            if ids[j] == ids[i]:
                first = False
                break
        if not first:
            continue
        c = 0
        t = 0
        for j in range(n):
            if ids[j] == ids[i]:
                c += 1
                t += qs[j]
        lines.append(f"{ids[i]} {c} {t}")
    print("\n".join(lines))


main()
